subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should the public `agents set-identity --identity-file` workflow adopt the existing 2 MiB workspace bootstrap cap, with oversized files rejected and the limit surfaced to users?
rationale: The bounded reader is the appropriate OOM defense, but extending the limit to a previously unlimited documented CLI path is an intentional compatibility decision rather than a CI-settled implementation detail.

options.title: Adopt and surface the shared cap
options.body: Keep the shared 2 MiB boundary, report oversized imports clearly, document the limit, and require current-head live CLI proof.

options.title: Preserve unlimited explicit imports
options.body: Leave the workspace loader bounded but retain the old explicit-import behavior, accepting the remaining memory-exhaustion path.

recommendation.title: Adopt and surface the shared cap
recommendation.body: Keep the shared 2 MiB boundary, report oversized imports clearly, document the limit, and require current-head live CLI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They previously reviewed and merged the identity-file contract and explicitly evaluated workspace-versus-config identity behavior.
